explicit_propositions.text: There are ten thousand promoters worldwide.
There are nearly 400,000 customers globally.
The speaker is the number one earner in the company.
Every customer, not just promoters, can save 22% through Smart Ship.
Customers receive products for free by referring two people using their unique code.
The retailer bonus is the most important promotion in the organization.
Hitting the MVP Multiplier generates a $500 monthly bonus on top of commissions.
A consistent influx of four new customers per month enables business growth.
Customers do not care about internal conflicts among promoters or organizational drama.
Customers prioritize product benefits over operational issues like website functionality.

assumptions.text: Customer satisfaction leads to organic referrals and sustainable business growth.
Focusing on customers rather than recruitment creates a more trustworthy and ethical business model.
Product quality and tangible benefits are the primary drivers of customer loyalty.
Long-term business success depends on building relationships with actual users, not just distributors.
Network marketing’s negative reputation stems from excessive recruitment-focused behavior.
Promoters who are also customers are more likely to stay engaged and perform effectively.
People are motivated to join when they see real financial incentives tied to performance.
The compensation plan should reward customer acquisition and retention, not just distributor recruitment.
Business sustainability requires shifting away from constant rebuilding due to high turnover.
Audience members value authenticity and meaningful impact over aggressive sales tactics.
